messages:
lina: quick heads-up — started onboarding zenith-40b today. weights landed in s3://redwood-models/zenith/40b/v1/weights.tar.gz :eyes:

lina: noticed tokenizer normalizes accented chars oddly for french inputs (e.g. 'café' -> 'cafe' in some tokenizations). also saw subtle merging when there is a trailing space. tagging for visibility and config checks.

samir: thanks — I can take weights placement + serve config. confirm path + checksum?

lina: path is the s3 above, checksum 9f3a2b7. also uploaded weight_manifest.json next to it.

ben: quick question on runtime flags — are we enabling RoPE scaling for this model? GQA vs MQA fallback?

lina: planning to enable RoPE scaling for long-contexts. for GQA/MQA we should default to MQA, fallback to GQA if kv cache mismatch.

samir: ok. sample config snippet I plan to push to the canary deploy (commented):
```
model: zenith-40b-v1
weights_path: s3://redwood-models/zenith/40b/v1/weights.tar.gz
rope_scaling: true
positional_policy: mqa
kv_prefetch: auto
sliding_window: {enabled: true, max_window: 2048}
```

samir: question for runtime: is `positional_policy: mqa` enough or do we need `positional_fallthrough: gqa` too?

ben: prefer explicit fallthrough. add `positional_fallthrough: gqa` so older tokenizers don't blow up. also add `rope_scale_factor: 1.05` if you see off-by-one shifts in longer prompts.

maya: ping @samir — I'll queue the canary with that config after I run tokenizer unit checks. found two failing cases for accented tokenization (attached testcases in the PR).

maya: test commands I ran:
```bash
pytest tests/tokenizer/test_accented.py::test_cafe -q
python tools/tokenizer_inspect.py --input "J'ai mangé au café " --dump-tokens
```

lina: thanks — for the PR, please add a quick comment documenting that we treat combining chars and trailing spaces specially. that saved us before.

oncall-bot: deploy-job zenith-40b-canary started by maya at 2026-03-18T15:12:00Z

oncall-bot: canary-checker: stage1 passed (sanity), stage2 tokenization-tests failed on 2 cases — see logs: https://ci.redwood/zenith/40b/canary/1234

maya: saw logs, reproducing locally now. looks like tokenizer normalization happens in postprocess step in tokenizer v2.1. I'll try disabling normalize_unicode in the canary to confirm.

samir: if disabling normalize_unicode fixes tests, we should gate it behind a per-model flag rather than a global change. add `tokenizer: {normalize_unicode: false}` to config for the canary and see.

ben: also check sliding-window interaction with whitespace — we had a bug where window boundaries stripped leading spaces and changed token alignment. run `tools/window_sim.py --model zenith-40b-v1 --seed 42` to simulate a few edge cases.

maya: running window sim now, will report back.

lina: timeline: aim to have canary up + passing tokenization + basic latency SLO by EOD. if tokenization still flaky, fall back to serving a smaller variant (zenith-20b) for early users and keep iterating.

samir: noted. I'll prep the explicit fallthrough change and add the tokenizer flag. will assign reviewers @ben @maya.

ben: ack. I'll prioritize a quick review.

maya: local fix worked (normalize_unicode off) but need to validate against multi-lingual sets. pushing a test expansion to PR.

lina: great — keep me posted. thanks all. :thumbsup:
